name: lodash-frompairs-key-casing
behavioral_change: lodash 4.0.0 changed the input form of `_.zipObject`: v_old accepted an array of `[key, value]` pairs, while v_new takes a keys array and a values array. Passing the old pair form to v_new does not throw; each pair is stringified into a key with value `undefined`, producing objects such as `{ 'A,3': undefined, 'B,4': undefined }`. The same release added `_.fromPairs` for the pair form.
downstream_effect: The downstream project (key-casing) rebuilds objects with `_(obj).map(keyMapper).zipObject().value()` in `index.js`; after the upgrade the conversion silently yields the malformed objects above at every level. The three tape failures print expected and actual values with frames only in `test.js`; lodash, `zipObject`, `fromPairs` and `index.js` never appear.
reference_fix: The reference fix changes the two `.zipObject()` calls in `index.js` to `.fromPairs()`.
documented_in: The lodash Changelog v4.0.0 (https://github.com/lodash/lodash/wiki/Changelog), section Compatibility Warnings, Split out methods list, states that `_.zipObject` was split into `_.fromPairs`. Tier 2: prose only; the call form is derived from the `_.fromPairs` jsdoc.
failing_tests: test.js :: validate object is expected default
test.js :: validate object that contains an array
test.js :: validate object that contains an array and nested objects
